The striker Nuno scored twice in the second half.
Our new neighbour Njeri brought us a basket of fruit.
The poet Narges read her verses at the festival.
In the final over, Nkem hit a six to win the match.
The architect Nima designed the new library.
My classmate Nuri lent me his notes for the exam.
President Nasser spoke to a huge crowd in Cairo.
